name: Montana 4-H County Ambassador and State Ambassador Officer
city: Statewide, Montana (county offices; state team based in Bozeman)
what_you_do: Serve as a 4-H county ambassador. Ambassadors who have shown leadership in their county can apply for a state officer role.
who_can_apply: Must be 14 by October 1 of the current year, enrolled in 4-H for at least 2 years and this year, and be or have been a Junior Leader or club officer. A maximum age is not stated on the program page.
pay_detail: Unpaid leadership role. Cost not stated on the program page.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: County ambassador: apply through your county 4-H (dates set by each county). State officer applications are due, postmarked, by June 15.
how_to_apply: County level: fill out an application. Then interview with the County Council. State officer: send the application to the Montana 4-H Center. It must be postmarked by June 15.
notes: You must already be in 4-H. The state team page lists five state officer jobs (for example President and Publicity Chair). Contact your county extension office. The state officer page does not state the term length for officers.
